correctness.rationale: For FIFO departures D_i nondecreasing and arrivals A_i strictly increasing, B_i(ell)>=k iff D_(i-k)>A_i+ell; F_(i-k)(ell)>=k iff the same strict inequality. Shifting indexes in an arrival-stationary array yields equal entire nonnegative-integer count distributions, equal independent Bernoulli-mark infection risks, and at most k empirical exceedance difference per fixed window. Under iid renewal inputs the tagged sojourn T and older overlaps/labels depend on past plus tagged service whereas later contacts use future increments and labels, giving conditional independence given T for a fixed ell. In unit-service M/D/1, when W=T-1=m+r with 0<r<1 predecessor departure offsets r,r+1,...,r+m give b_ell(t)=m+1_{r>ell}; future marked arrivals to time T-ell are Poisson(lambda*p*(T-ell)). Near t=1 the preceding risk vanishes; for t>(2a-lambda*p*ell)/(a-lambda*p) with a=-log(1-p)>lambda*p, the earlier risk dominates. The workload LST E exp(-sW)=(1-lambda)*s/(s-lambda+lambda*exp(-s)) gives the exact common marginal formula, with the mass at W=0 handled. An independent bounded parameter check verified opposite signs in both regimes for three (lambda,p,ell) sets; no simulation was treated as universal proof.
residual_risks: Conditional independence needs independent *future renewal* increments, marks and fixed threshold; does not claim full G/G/1 generality for that part.
Integer waiting times above zero form a null set but the idle atom T=1 is treated separately.

value.rationale: The question is motivated by explicit Newman–Pender Conjecture 3.10 on infection direction in FIFO queues. Showing unconditional equality holds pathwise/stationarily while conditional independence does not imply identical conditional distribution is a substantive mathematical distinction, with a positive-measure reversal in a standard deterministic-service queue. Exact marked infection formulas and their regimes can be reused in queueing epidemiology; the claim is not merely routine derivation of an old workload LST.
residual_risks: Scope excludes common random thresholds, nonrenewal conditional independence and secondary transmission; this does not diminish the targeted conjecture resolution.
